risk_note: RV2 ledger and identity: the deletion closing gate's stand-in (app.module) becomes the real port. Entering processing with a balance prefills one PENDING ACCOUNT_CLOSED form in the same transaction, with a system audit (system:ledger, adjustment_prefill, CT-26u) only when the insert lands. adminApproveAdjustment (fund.adjust, sms step-up) locks users, balance and the form row, re-reads the balance and posts at approval time; no balance → adjust_no_balance; a lost race with a reject → 20902 with everything rolled back. adminRejectAdjustment is readOnly. After a reject or a reversal the gate stays pending and a new form is prefilled once per accounting day (D10-590 ③). Every state write goes through transitionAdminAdjustment, including B2-12c's one-step submit (fixed here). Integration admin-adjustments-closing + admin-adjustments + deletion-processing + spec/admin 793 pass, 0 fail. Open FU: none new beyond FU-PREFILL-AUDIT now done.
